text: The refactored code replaced jsonwebtoken with the jose library for JWT verification, using async/await support and better cryptographic defaults.
The refactored code optimizes database queries by fetching all products in a single ANY() query instead of N separate queries, reducing round trips and improving performance.
The refactored code implements atomic batch stock updates using a SQL CASE statement to prevent race conditions where concurrent checkouts could oversell inventory.
The refactored code adds pre-validation of all cart items before performing any database mutations to ensure atomicity and fail fast.
The refactored code adds a response_sent flag to prevent multiple response writes if errors occur after headers are sent, making error handling safer.
The refactored code improves error messages to be generic for security and adds server-side logging for debugging without exposing internal details to clients.
